errors.unavailable: runners are not available on this instance
errors.protocol: this runner speaks protocol {got}; the daemon takes {min} to {max}. Update the runner
errors.log_too_large: a log chunk is limited to 4 MB
errors.no_output_dir: this run has no output directory on the daemon
errors.task_mixes_runners: a task's projects must all run on the same runner
errors.task_without_runner: the task has no project on a runner
errors.engine_not_supported: a runner cannot run {engine}: its script needs a container
errors.runner_outdated: runner {runner} speaks protocol {got} and this run needs {want}: update thulu on that machine and launch again
errors.task_not_on_runner: the task has a project on a runner, but this run was not placed on it
errors.no_kill: this runtime cannot stop a run
errors.push_on_runner: project {project} runs its agents on a runner, which pushes the task branch from its machine; the daemon does not push it
errors.folder_not_absolute: {path} is not an absolute path on the runner's machine
errors.no_folders_reported: the runner {runner} has not reported its folders yet: start it on its machine (thulu runner run), and update it if it is older than this version
errors.folder_not_allowed: {path} is outside the folders {runner} allows ({roots}). Add the folder on that machine with thulu runner allow
errors.folder_taken: {path} is already the folder of project {project} on this machine
errors.add_name_taken: there is already a project called {name} in this workspace: pick another name with -name
errors.steer_not_running: the run has not started on its machine yet; the message waits for the next run
errors.steer_too_large: a message for a running agent is limited to {max} KB
errors.steer_sealed: the agent stopped reading messages; the message waits for the next run
errors.steer_locked: the agent's message queue stayed locked; the message waits for the next run
errors.steer_failed: the machine could not hand the message to the agent ({result}); the message waits for the next run
errors.steer_timeout: the machine did not take the message within 10 s; the message waits for the next run
errors.turn_unfinished: machine {runner} did not finish the chat turn in time: check that thulu runner run is still going there, then send the message again

log.queued: queued for runner {runner}; waiting for it to take the run
log.expire_failed: end the runs nobody answered for: {err}
log.expired: {count} runner runs ended without an answer
log.lost: runner {runner} stopped answering (or never took the run); the run is marked failed
log.read_log_failed: read the log of runner run {job}; the recorded session has none
log.write_log_failed: write the log of runner run {job}
log.adopt_folder_failed: record the folder the runner {runner} maps for project {project}
log.turn_output_missing: the machine finished the chat turn, but its answer never reached the daemon
log.orphan_turns_failed: find the chat turns a previous daemon left on the machines: {err}
log.adopted: {count} runner runs were running when the daemon started; their runners have {grace} to report back before the runs are marked failed
log.adopt_failed: give the runner runs a previous daemon left running a fresh lease: {err}

audit.project_runner_set: Project {project} now runs its agents on runner {runner}
audit.project_runner_cleared: Project {project} runs its agents on this instance again
audit.project_folder_set: Project {project} now uses the folder {path} on its runner
